research_result.description: Netlify is a hosting and automation platform for web applications that offers comprehensive infrastructure management, atomic deployments, serverless functions, and database controls through a REST API, CLI, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can self-register a free Netlify account and generate Personal Access Tokens (PATs) under User Settings > Applications > Personal access tokens, or register an OAuth application to obtain a Client ID and Secret for user delegation.

evidence.claim: Netlify provides a REST API to manage site deployments, forms, JavaScript snippets, DNS, environment variables, databases, and functions.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS, and so much more.

evidence.claim: Netlify supports OAuth 2.0 and personal access tokens authenticated via Bearer headers.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS.

evidence.claim: Netlify provides self-serve pricing options including a Free plan.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Learn about our standard self-serve Credit-based plans in this doc, such as the Free, Personal, and Pro plans.

evidence.claim: Netlify maintains an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI agents to interact with the Netlify API and CLI.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Built on Anthropic’s open source Model Context Protocol, our MCP Server gives agents direct access to the Netlify API and CLI.
